room_rent.note: Standard Single Room base; modifiable; copay if higher room category chosen

icu.note: ICU admission always paid up to Sum Insured

copayment.note: No mandatory base co-pay; optional co-pay available; copay applies if higher room category opted

sub_limits.note: Cataract etc. only in specific-disease waiting list, no rupee cap noted

deductible.note: Annual Aggregate Deductible optional (cannot combine with co-payment)

ped_waiting.note: 12 / 24 / 36 months as per variant selected; modifiable at purchase

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 / 12 months as per variant; cancer 30-day wait, accident day 1

maternity.note: Inbuilt M-iracle maternity SI (variant-based waiting), new born day 1, ectopic under hospitalization; India only

cumulative_bonus.note: Unutilized Base SI carries forward up to 10x (entry-age/variant); not a flat NCB %

restoration.note: First paid claim triggers ReAssure+/ReAssureX Forever — unlimited reinstatement of Base SI for life

ambulance.display: Road & Air up to Base SI
ambulance.note: Road and air ambulance both up to Base Sum Insured

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables via optional Safeguard cover

global_cover.note: Covers allopathic treatment anywhere in the world inbuilt; Borderless benefit also available

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity (M-iracle) & some benefits India only; standard Excl01–18

optional_riders.display: Borderless (global), Cash-Bag, WellConsult OPD, Personal Accident, Hospital Daily Cash, PED/room modification, Co-payment, Deductible
